title: the gods lie.
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Eleven-year-old Natsuru moves to a new town with his single mother and befriends classmate Rio, who is secretly raising her little brother alone while their father is supposedly fishing in Alaska. Over a summer Natsuru learns the household's secret, including the grandfather Rio buried in the yard, and tries to help the siblings run away. A one-volume story from Vertical; School Library Journal recommends it for grades 4 to 7, while Solrad warns of child neglect and death.
life_message: It holds up loyalty, honesty and the need for children to have trustworthy adults around them.
